name: Kaela's Update
summary: Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with letters taken from the Venture Company. Their contents help the Sentinels follow the goblin cartel's work in Stonetalon.

sections.title: A Messenger in the Mountains
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle sends you back to Kaela Shadowspear with captured letters. After you helped the gnome mage uncover Venture Company movements, he gathered correspondence detailing the cartel's operations. Kaela, a night elf Sentinel coordinator near Windshear Crag, is waiting for the letters. Gaxim also wants you to mention how his magic helped the investigation.

sections.title: Eyes of the Sentinels
sections.body: The Sentinels watch Stonetalon's crags with concern. Horde forces contest the lower trails, while the Venture Company cuts trees and mines the land. Its letters give Kaela a look at the cartel's communications and help the Alliance plan its defenses along the ridges.

faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf Sentinel officer at a camp near Windshear Crag. She oversees scouting and defenses against the Horde and goblin mining companies in the mountains.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome mage in the Stonetalon Mountains. He uses magic to investigate and disrupt Venture Company operations, working with the local night elf Sentinels.

faq.q: What is in the Venture Company letters?
faq.answer: The letters contain Venture Company communications intercepted during operations against its camps. They give Kaela Shadowspear and the Sentinels information about the cartel's local logistics, excavations, and resource stripping.

faq.q: Why are the Sentinels concerned about the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company cuts sacred forests and mines the earth with heavy machinery. The Sentinels see its industrial work as a threat to nature and the sanctity of Stonetalon.

faq.q: Where does this quest start and end?
faq.answer: You begin with Gaxim Rustfizzle along the mountain pathways and finish with Kaela Shadowspear at her camp near Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further investigations?
faq.answer: Delivering the letters keeps the Sentinels informed about the cartel's activity. Kaela can use that knowledge to plan further military responses and scouting across Stonetalon.

angles.text: For the Alliance, carrying intercepted Venture Company letters strengthens its fragile foothold in Stonetalon against the cartel's pillaging.
As a night elf, each scrap of intelligence against the Venture Company helps the Sentinels protect Kalimdor's scarred wilderness from industrial harm.
As a gnome, you can take pride in Gaxim Rustfizzle's arcane skill as he makes sure his night elf allies see the value of gnome magic.
